## Install — 3 steps

1. **Download one jar** from the table (you need Fabric with
   [Meteor Client](https://meteorclient.com/) and Xaero's World Map).
2. **Drop it into your `mods` folder** and start the game.
3. **Open the XaeroTools tab** in Meteor's top bar —
   [setup guide](https://github.com/dekrom/xaerotools-companion#setup).

Works with any
[XaeroTools](https://github.com/dekrom/xaerotools/releases/latest) release
0.2 or newer. `SHA256SUMS.txt` verifies your download.
